name: gherkin-java-runner
displayName: Gherkin Runner for Java (Cucumber · Maven · Gradle)
description: Run and debug Cucumber scenarios, single Examples rows and tag expressions from VS Code's Test Explorer. Works with Maven and Gradle. Ctrl+click a step to jump to its Java step definition.
author: Mahdi Mohammad

gherkinRunner.buildTool.description: Build tool used to compile tests and resolve the test classpath. 'auto' looks for pom.xml / build.gradle next to the feature file and upwards.

gherkinRunner.mavenExecutable.description: Maven executable. Empty = use the project's mvnw wrapper if present, otherwise 'mvn' on PATH.

gherkinRunner.gradleExecutable.description: Gradle executable. Empty = use the project's gradlew wrapper if present, otherwise 'gradle' on PATH.

gherkinRunner.mavenArgs.description: Extra arguments for the Maven compile step, e.g. ["-o", "-Pintegration"].

gherkinRunner.gradleArgs.description: Extra arguments for the Gradle compile step, e.g. ["--offline"].

gherkinRunner.compileBeforeRun.description: Compile tests and refresh the classpath before every run. When off, the classpath from the previous run of that module is reused.

gherkinRunner.javaHome.description: JDK used to run Cucumber. Empty = JAVA_HOME, then java.jdt.ls.java.home, then 'java' on PATH.

gherkinRunner.glue.description: Glue packages (step definitions/hooks). Empty = read cucumber.glue from junit-platform.properties / cucumber.properties / the runner class, otherwise auto-detect from classes that use Cucumber.

gherkinRunner.env.description: Extra environment variables for the test JVM.

gherkinRunner.prettyOutput.description: Show each step and @Before/@After hook in the Test Results panel. While on, console formatters from cucumber.plugin (e.g. 'progress') are not used.

gherkinRunner.tags.markdownDescription: Tag expression applied to **every** run, e.g. `not @wip`. Combined with `and` when you run by tag expression.

gherkinRunner.featureGlob.description: Glob used to find feature files.

gherkinRunner.stepDefinitionGlob.description: Glob used to find step definition source files for Ctrl+click navigation.

gherkinRunner.exclude.description: Glob of folders to ignore when looking for features and step definitions.

gherkinRunner.diagnostics.undefinedSteps.description: Show a warning on steps that have no matching step definition.

gherkinRunner.debug.attachTimeout.description: Seconds to wait for the test JVM to open its debug port.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run build -- --production && vsce package --no-dependencies
